basics.name: Carmina Nascimento
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Distributed Systems
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing and evolving backend systems for globally used enterprise products at Motorola and Samsung. Experienced in Kotlin, Java, C#/.NET, Python, Spring Boot, Google Cloud Platform, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures. Strong background in system architecture, backend modernization, scalability, technical leadership, and cross-functional product development. Experienced in mentoring engineers and using LLMs and engineering automation to improve developer productivity and software delivery.

work.name: Instituto de Pesquisas Eldorado
highlights: Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native backend services for globally used Motorola engineering platforms using Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, Python (Flask), MySQL, and Google Cloud Platform.
Develop RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations using Google Cloud Pub/Sub and asynchronous messaging, enabling scalable communication between distributed systems.
Contribute to architectural decisions across monolithic and distributed services, improving scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform evolution.
Improved the performance of a core product workflow by optimizing backend processing and database queries, reducing response time from 1 minute 40 seconds to 17 seconds — an 83% improvement.

Led the technical delivery of a new customer-feedback capability from design through production, defining the architecture and data model, implementing backend and frontend components, and coordinating data integration with Product Management and consuming teams.

Championed a documentation-first engineering culture by authoring 20+ technical documents, including onboarding guides, architecture documentation, Engineering Decision Records (EDRs), database schemas, and development workflows.
Mentor trainees and interns, contributing to the conversion of two interns into full-time engineers.

Designed and developed LLM-powered developer productivity tools adopted across the engineering team, including an assistant that analyzes Jira change requests together with the codebase to explain requirements and identify impacted components.

Developed an AI-assisted workflow adopted across the team that generates and updates unit tests based on source code changes, reducing manual test scaffolding while preserving developer review and quality standards.

Served as a primary technical contact for platform users, gathering feedback, translating user needs into technical requirements, and partnering with Product Management to prioritize product improvements.

work.name: Sidia Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia
highlights: Designed and developed backend and enterprise software for globally used Samsung quality platforms using Java, C#, .NET, REST APIs, MySQL, and related technologies across multiple strategic initiatives.

Assumed technical leadership of a critical project following the departure of the technical lead, planning delivery, coordinating 2 software engineering interns, leading technical discussions, collaborating with Samsung stakeholders, and successfully delivering the remaining project scope.

Designed and developed a centralized quality management platform for Samsung's Latin America QA hub, enabling approximately 25 QA engineers to manage 80+ concurrent testing projects, execution status, and validation results through a web application that remains in active use.
Designed scalable backend services and REST APIs supporting enterprise quality assurance workflows and cross-system integrations.
Led the modernization of legacy backend services by migrating APIs to .NET 5, improving maintainability, reliability, and long-term platform evolution.

Modernized a large legacy analytics platform by refactoring backend services, migrating business logic from the frontend to the backend, and improving application architecture while continuing to deliver new features.

Optimized backend services and database operations powering near real-time dashboards and reporting for Samsung device quality monitoring, processing data from thousands of devices daily while improving responsiveness and scalability.
Established automated quality gates by implementing GitLab CI pipelines that enforced unit test coverage thresholds and prevented quality regressions during continuous integration.
Participated in architecture discussions, conducted code reviews, and led large-scale refactoring initiatives that reduced technical debt and improved long-term maintainability.
